The federal government was well aware of the myocarditis signal following COVID-19 vaccines, particularly in young men, as early as February 2021.

Despite months of discussion and apparent acknowledgment of the safety concern, U.S. health officials decided not to issue a warning on the Health Alert Network.

More on this in today's PSI hearing.

U.S. Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations Majority Staff Interim Report

Failure to Warn: How Federal Health Agencies Downplayed the Risk of Myocarditis and Other Adverse Events Following COVID-19 Vaccination

I applaud @SecKennedy and @SecRubio for formally rejecting the dangerous IHR amendments. The Biden Administration tried to surrender our sovereignty to the WHO. 

America should not allow unelected global bureaucrats to dictate our health policy. This is a huge win for medical freedom.

.@SecKennedy’s main challenge is restoring integrity and credibility to science and to the federal health agencies. 

He’s up against powerful forces who do not want to know the root causes of chronic illness or autism.

The good news is that the American people want to know. https://t.co/gqy3OH1Qtk

What do you say to a parent whose perfectly healthy and developing child is vaccinated, runs a high fever, has a seizure, and never speaks another word?   

All we are asking is for people, doctors, and health officials to have an open mind and help us discover the root causes to prevent future injuries.

VAERS, V-safe, and now Rasmussen again. These safety signals may not prove causation, but they should spark far greater concern. 

Many Americans believe COVID shots are killing people. When will the medical establishment start listening?

.@SenSanders is simply wrong when he asks, “Are you prepared … to sit back and allow over 20 million Americans to see a doubling of their health care premiums?”

Calling all fact checkers!

The TRUTH is that 22 of the 24 million Americans on Obamacare exchanges will continue receiving Obamacare subsidies as originally designed. The dollar amount of those subsidies will likely increase, not decrease, since they are tied to Obamacare’s skyrocketing premiums.  

For people who paid nothing under the enhanced subsidy, asking them to pay a small amount is an infinite increase — but you can’t double zero. 

Fewer than 2 million Americans with incomes above 400% of the Federal Poverty Line will lose the temporary COVID relief subsidies that Democrats set to expire. I’m happy to work with Democrats to ensure that those people have affordable health care insurance options, but first they need to stop lying and admit that Obamacare is a miserable failure.

.@SenSanders was fact-checked: “Will 2026 Obamacare premiums double for 20 million Americans?”

Wisconsin Watch: NO
https://t.co/7HpyhuTRaa

Fact checkers nationwide need to call out this big lie from every Democrat repeating it — including @SenatorBaldwin.

Free markets guarantee lower prices, better quality, and better service. We don’t have that in health care because Obamacare reduced free market competition.  

Bring back consumerism and let people decide what they want to purchase — not the government. https://t.co/9BrgvPGlYq

The first step in solving a problem is admitting you have one.

I encourage everyone to tune in to this important conversation. https://t.co/G9u2EBtoTL
